# /crav1-draft-commit-message

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From commit to merge](../../from-commit.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-draft-commit-message/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Draft a paste-ready commit Summary and Description only.

Paste-ready Summary/Description for any git client; CRAV1 style or live git log, once or onward (deletable rule); does not commit unless they ask. Optional Azure Boards mention from `docs/specs/<slug>/work-item.md` is the last description line.

## Runs when

About to commit. Called by the user and by [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md).

## Reads

In short: The diff, recent git log, and `work-item.md`.

Reads the staged or unstaged diff, recent `git log`, an existing persist rule, and `work-item.md` when it exists. The mention picks the id whose milestone or slice label matches the slice being worked, asks when that is unclear, and still reads a single unlabeled line.

## Writes

In short: A host persist rule when onward is chosen; a commit only when also asked in that turn.

Writes a host persist rule only when the user chooses onward.

## Does not

Leaves the git commit alone.

Limits and exceptions: commits only when the user also asked to commit in that turn.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls no skill.

## Lane and group

Lane: Cross-cutting. Group: Commit and pull request. Starter option: no. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).

## Stage and since

Stage: stable. Since: 1.0.0 ([changelog](../../../CHANGELOG.md)).
